# V SPACEZ
> Event venue in Nungambakkam, Chennai for social functions, corporate meetups, workshops, and celebrations. Three halls — Varnam, Vizha, and Vaan — across 5,000 sq.ft.

V SPACEZ (also written VSpacez) is at No. 131, 3rd Floor, Yesde House, Valluvar Kottam High Rd, Nungambakkam, Chennai 600034, India. Bookings and enquiries are open: phone +91 79047 57565, WhatsApp https://wa.me/917904757565, email vspacezofficial@gmail.com. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/vspacez/

Halls can be hired stand-alone or together. Amenities include central air conditioning, valet parking, green rooms, Wi-Fi and AV (music system, projector screen, mics), furniture, in-house or outside catering, and customized decor.

## Pages
- [Home](https://vspacez.co.in/index.md): Venue overview, halls, amenities, and contact
- [Privacy policy](https://vspacez.co.in/privacy.md): How V SPACEZ collects and uses information

## Spaces
- [Varnam](https://vspacez.co.in/index.md): 3rd-floor hall used as a dining space and for art workshops, children’s theatre, pop-up shows, open mics, and small gatherings
- [Vizha](https://vspacez.co.in/index.md): 4th-floor festive hall for traditional events, private parties, cultural nights, and comedy
- [Vaan](https://vspacez.co.in/index.md): 5th-floor hall with panoramic city views and natural light, for yoga, workshops, ceremonies, and photo shoots
